item.title: Ecosystem track: wallets, extension, hardware signing, DEX, ZIP infrastructure
item.body:
The parts of Phase 1 that users touch: a wallet on a phone, an audited extension that
becomes a Sentry, hardware signing, a venue to trade on, and a ZIP process that does not
depend on one hosting provider.

- Mobile wallets built from the Syrius Flutter code
- Ed25519 signing on Ledger and Trezor class devices
- SDK relay support in `znn.ts` and Syrius once the link format is a ZIP
